title.narrative: Latin American Caritas Women’s Leadership Strengthening for International Advocacy

description.narrative:
Caritas Latinoamericana and CAFOD are working together to support four women leaders from the Caritas family in the region to strengthen their understanding and skills on the English language, with an objective of enhancing their opportunities to meaningfully engage in and influence key policy and advocacy processes, spaces and platforms.
Specifically, we’d like to support, Valquiria Lima, Caritas Brazil National Exectutive-Diretor, Indinayara Gouveia, Caritas Brazil Collegiate Coordiantor, Catherine Mella Quiroz, Caritas Chile Programme Coordinator, and Gloria Paola Oviedo Martínez, Caritas Mexico Humanitarian Project Coordinator, to travel to England and stay for a 4 weeks period to attend an English course and embed themselves in an English-speaking country and working environment, as well as spending time with policy/advocacy staff and other experts in London with experience of engaging with relevant global-level policy processes related to their priority advocacy agendas.
Although this project is a SELACC initiative, Caritas Italy is funding all the UK-base related activities, such as the accommodation, English course, transport, food and stipend for four weeks. CAFOD will be receiving and managing the funds to cover the uk base costs of the visit.
Their flights is covered by Caritas Poland via Caritas Regional Conference for Latin America and the Caribbean.
